title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing items into popular (short head) and unpopular (long tail) groups, and evaluating the distribution of recommended items using Average Recommendation Popularity (ARP) and the Average Percentage of Long Tail Items (APT).

Measuring the recommendation performance and exposure disparities across different user gender groups using Hit Rate Difference (HD) and Demographic Parity (DP), tested under both implicit (attributes not in prompt) and explicit (attributes in prompt) scenarios.
